digest.component_or_area: Plan Review Gate / Operator-Attested Evidence Contract
propositions: Operator-attested evidence currently lacks measurement-provenance declaration, allowing escapes where attestations are valid but measurements taken in wrong environment or under insufficient privilege relative to production

Two specific escapes occurred: bedrock measurements taken in account 579718921998/us-east-2 attested for work targeting 896586841071/us-east-1, and live API calls under bedrock:* privilege offered as validation of scoped bedrock:InvokeModel grant that would have failed in production

The contract must be extended to require four provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) declared as continuation lines under [operator-attested] checkboxes, with deterministic presence/shape checking and LLM-based semantic validation against repo facts

Deterministic check must validate non-placeholder values and enum membership only; LLM criterion must detect repo contradictions (declared environment vs Terraform backend), flag broader privilege on scoped permissions, and distinguish live-call from simulation/static-analysis for authorization claims

Evidence mechanism must force measurement context into the record as queryable text, enabling repo-grounded contradiction detection without re-running world measurements or auditing the measurement instrument itself
